Description: Own currency exchange rates, quote calculation, rate capture, provider fetch, freshness policy, and applied-rate audit surface for the multi-domain SaaS platform.
Acceptance Criteria: Component exposes Symfony-oriented service, route, doctrine, console, OpenAPI, and manifest surfaces without /src/Domain/ or ports/adapters drift.

Summary: Wire Exchanging services and Doctrine mapping in host app
Description: Import config/services/exchange_services.yaml, config/packages/exchange_provider.yaml, and config/packages/exchange_doctrine.yaml from the host app.
Acceptance Criteria: Host app can compile container and discover Exchanging repositories, services, and Doctrine entities.

Summary: Expose Exchanging HTTP quote and capture endpoints
Description: Import config/routes/exchange_routes.yaml and verify POST /exchanging/quote and POST /exchanging/rates/capture.
Acceptance Criteria: OpenAPI contract matches controller behavior for 200, 201, 400, 404, and 409 responses.

Description: Run exchanging:rate:capture, exchanging:quote, exchanging:rate:fetch, and exchanging:rate:fetch-capture in a host app.
Acceptance Criteria: Commands are discoverable through bin/console and return expected success/failure behavior.

Summary: Configure Exchanging freshness policy and provider parameters
Acceptance Criteria: Host app has explicit parameter values and quote freshness enforcement behavior is intentional.

Summary: Review Exchanging applied-rate audit integration points
Description: Confirm how Ordering, Paying, and Taxating persist audit payloads generated by ExchangeAppliedRateAuditServiceInterface.
Acceptance Criteria: Consumer components can store auditKey and auditPayload without Exchanging taking over their persistence responsibility.
